paper_title: Linking Human Milk Oligosaccharides, Infant Fecal Community Types, and Later Risk To Require Antibiotics

pico.outcome: Previously reported lower rates of infection-related medication use with HMOs may therefore be linked to gut microbiota community types.

supplement: inetervention_period_day changes the unit from months to days. Comparison with breastfed infants is also conducted. Samples before intervention are not collected.
